primitives.name: Murphy Decomposition
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## The Murphy identity needed care On a sample, `brier - (reliability - resolution + uncertainty)` is **not** zero in general.
primitives.assumptions: Forecast probabilities are properly calibrated and bins are sufficiently fine-grained.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When binning is too coarse or when systematic bias exists in probability estimates.

layer2.telemetry: Residual binning variance computed independently via two methods to verify consistency.

primitives.name: Relabeling Null Hypothesis
primitives.verbatim_quote: **The relabeling null's orientation was wrong, and the API changed because of it.** A p-value alone lies here: a *uniformly* better candidate wins under **every** relabeling, so its p is ~1 while it is maximally robust, whereas a lucky arrangement has a low p because relabeling does better.
primitives.assumptions: Under the null, all label permutations yield equivalent performance; uniformity of p-values implies no signal.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When relabeling reveals inconsistent performance across permutations indicating potential overfitting or spurious correlation.

layer2.mapping: In GSI, used to validate robustness of model selection against label permutations; in GSE, serves as a decision boundary for model stability.
layer2.telemetry: Survival of relabeling test determines whether a model passes or fails the robustness check.

primitives.name: BigInt Precision Guard
primitives.verbatim_quote: Raised to a 4096-bit runaway guard, documented as such (BigInt never silently rounds, so it is not a precision guard).
primitives.assumptions: Arithmetic operations must maintain full precision without silent truncation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When floating-point arithmetic introduces rounding errors that compromise numerical integrity.

layer2.mapping: Ensures GSI maintains high-precision computations for probabilistic forecasts; supports GSE's deterministic state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Verification that arithmetic results match expected values up to 1e-12 tolerance.
